Posts can contain Python cells like this one. Jupyter notebooks (`.ipynb`) also work as posts:
put `index.ipynb` in a new folder under `blog/posts/` instead of `index.qmd`.

```{python}
from capstone.topics import topic_map

topic_map("Droughts", height=400)
```
